message:
chore(deps): patch Next.js and sharp across site and GUI (#6481)

* fix(deps): patch shared Next.js security version

Raise both Next minimums and the shared lock to 15.5.24 using verified npm 11.17.0. Preserve all eight SWC platform packages, Linux libc selectors, root overrides, and unrelated dependency entries.

Metadata-only generation is idempotent; actual Linux install and app validation remain required.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* ci(js): verify installed Next workspace resolution

Check the installed Next dependency tree and tracked lock/manifests immediately after the existing root npm ci, preserving its lifecycle and CI configuration.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* fix(deps): update sharp and align npm CI evidence

Resolve sharp0.35.4 and its required native dependencies under Next15.5.24 without changing workspace minimums or overrides. Update the advisory disposition while keeping the default-branch alert status explicit.

Inspect inline and literal-block root npm ci commands without losing wasm-pack ordering, and trigger installed-tree verification for either consumer manifest.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* ci(js): verify installed sharp can generate a native PNG

Check the loaded sharp version against the committed lock and report libvips versions after the existing root install. Require a nonempty one-pixel PNG and propagate synchronous or asynchronous failures.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>
